method: Independent source inspection of evidence agent probe results; no rerun needed

cross_review.reason: Replacement copies synthesis refs and assessor, changes result/reason on audit disagreement without checking audit refs. Readiness interprets copied refs as demonstrated failure.
cross_review.caveat: Probe directly invokes report builder with completed execution status; does not establish controller completed a failed audit. Readiness bug does not depend on that execution-status claim.

cross_review.reason: Graph rooting ignores support/refute polarity and evidence statuses; provider validation and durable claim persistence use the same rooting test, allowing the same contradicted proposition to retain model-supplied supported status.
cross_review.caveat: Reachability cannot establish semantic truth. A new opposite proposition may legitimately cite evidence contradicting an old proposition; require proposition-specific typed support/refute relations rather than rejecting every contradicted source.

cross_review.reason: Chronological dissent is truncated at 20 after audit critical defects are appended; early ordinary concerns can exclude final audit reasons from report UI/exports.
cross_review.caveat: Original contributions remain saved and generic final-audit unresolved flag survives. Earlier proposal-only critical defects are omitted, but absence of resolution records does not prove they remain unresolved after later audit passes.
